payload_schema_sources.object.id_schema: The selected object's public id property schema.
payload_schema_sources.object.kind_const: A string const containing the selected catalogued object kind.
payload_schema_sources.object.updateable_field_schemas: The selected object's public property schemas whose matrix classification is updateable.

semantics.name: Stable identity
semantics.rule: Object IDs and concrete kinds are immutable; the required kind discriminator must match the selected object and every update and move preserves both.

semantics.name: Partial update
semantics.rule: Only fields in changes are replaced; omitted fields retain their current values.

semantics.name: Null
semantics.rule: Explicit null is accepted only when the selected public field schema is nullable.

semantics.name: Strict payloads
semantics.rule: Unknown payload and change fields are rejected before dispatch; changes contains at least one field.

semantics.name: Move
semantics.rule: Moving changes only direct containment and position, preserves the complete subtree, rejects cycles and incompatible parents, uses an empty parent_id for root, accepts positions 0..N after removing the target, and appends when position is omitted.

semantics.name: Reorder
semantics.rule: Reordering requires an exact, duplicate-free permutation of the selected root or container's current direct member IDs; an empty parent_id selects root.

semantics.name: Retarget
semantics.rule: Relation members and annotation targets are ordered, preserve the owning object ID, and run existing reference, cardinality, kind, uniqueness, and diagram constraints.

semantics.name: No-op
semantics.rule: An unchanged patch, current placement, or current exact order is accepted without changing rendered or persisted state.

semantics.name: Atomic rejection
semantics.rule: Argument, operation, constraint, and unexpected failures restore the byte-for-byte snapshot that existed before the command.

semantics.name: Invalid pre-state
semantics.rule: Update, move, and reorder commit only when the resulting state can commit, even when the pre-state was already invalid.

semantics.name: Discovery
semantics.rule: Each supported operation has one name and a strict JSON-shaped schema discoverable through diagram_description and command_payload.

reorder_elements.applies_to: root and container direct element collections

classifications.updateable: Public semantic field; partial update preserves object identity.
classifications.move_or_reorder_only: Containment and order are owned by move/reorder commands.
classifications.immutable: Stable object identity or concrete kind.
